hero_h1: Built for the buyers who can't afford a mistake.
hero_lead: Government agencies, UN bodies and institutional food programmes require suppliers with verified food safety certification, ethical trading evidence and established regional presence. Bungle Group holds HACCP, SEDEX and FRESHCARE certification and is registered on the UN Global Marketplace.
who_heading: Procurement with very high barriers to entry — that we already clear.
who_body: We supply government agencies, UN bodies, NGOs and institutional food programmes across PNG and the Pacific. We're registered on the UN Global Marketplace and hold the certifications, supply-chain infrastructure and in-country presence these programmes require. Our ability to deliver into complex, remote environments makes us well-suited to humanitarian and government food procurement.
cyber_heading: When you put us on your supplier list, you're trusting us with more than food.
cyber_intro: Food businesses are now among the most-targeted sectors for ransomware — attacks rose 118% in late 2024 on the year before. When an institutional buyer shares tender documents, pricing and operational requirements, we treat that data with the same care we apply to our food. We take both cyber and physical security seriously, and we have the procedures to prove it.
